package.name: shin_spider
package.description: ROS1 (Noetic) port of the Processing "original_spider_controller" (ExercisesInCreativeRobotics2). Keeps the Robot / RobotLeg / RobotHand / Motion / Target / MotionList structure, drives the gamepad_command logic from sensor_msgs/Joy and sends [v]/[k]/[m] lines to the OpenCM firmware OpenCMSpiderMotion_v2.0_XC over serial. Rendering is not ported.
